verdict.rationale: A government online-incorporation service could reasonably publish a paper, in-person, or mail fallback, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the online flow: authentication methods, digital signing, online payment, and email notifications. No paper, fax, or mail alternative is given, and no addresses, phone or fax numbers, or downloadable forms appear. The 404 probe shows an entry URL failing but says nothing about any offline fallback being published.
